features: Sodium 16x16x16 section culling with protected 3D radius and opaque/any obstacle policy
Shared visibility scheduler and section results consumed before block-entity and Flywheel model tests
Conservative full-volume wall coverage proof, mesh readiness guard and column-revision cache
Dynamic Sodium minimum-radius limit follows pending view distance; Russian and English controls
limitations: CPU cache is read every frame; expensive proofs are budgeted and may be deferred
No guarantee of a net FPS gain, especially in open terrain; no 32-chunk user-world benchmark
Complex occluder arrangements may remain visible; uncertain results fail open
Flywheel restoration uses its existing bounded queue and may take multiple frames
Entities, particles, moving virtual worlds and Distant Horizons LOD are outside section-mask scope

integration.freshWorldAttempts: Initial attempts timed out before reliable section visibility; passed after preparing and reopening the isolated test world
